# large-data-vault

A synthetic Data Vault project of 1,374 tables (1,122 models and 252 sources) that stands in for a real
vehicle-auction vault: five business domains (hubs, links, satellites, PITs, dimensions and facts) and seven
source systems (36 sources and 36 staging models each). It is the input of the large-project tests: the
layers, kinds and names of the universe view at that size (M8.1), and later the cards, the skeleton and the
source-system lens (M8.2 to M8.5).

- **No input file is committed** (D-060). The input is generated by `tests/large_project.py`
  (`large_manifest()`, deterministic: seed 1374, no clock), with the config `LARGE_CONFIG` (preset
  `data_vault` and 12 `domains` rules on the schema). A page is `page_of(write_large_project(folder))`.
- `expected.json` holds the counts the generator must give: tables, domains, layers
  (Sources, Staging, Raw vault, Data products; no `other`), kinds (no `Other`), the relations and lineage
  links (within 5 % of the 906 and 1,379 of the real project), the shape of each business domain, and the
  three special satellites (one with no relationship, one with two parents, one in another domain than its
  parent hub).
- Tested by `tests/unit/test_large_project.py` (counts) and `tests/browser/test_roles.py` (the page).
- **Business-to-business lineage (M8.4).** Some data products (dimensions and facts) of a business domain read
  a hub of an upstream one, in place of their last parent (`FLOW` in `tests/large_project.py`): account, then
  vehicle, then auction, then claim and activity downstream. It gives the business-domain graph a flow order of
  five ranks, which the placement along the flow and its tests need. The replacement keeps every count (tables,
  relations and the 1,360 lineage links; the only change is 20 lineage links that now cross a domain, in the
  directions of `expected.json` `business_flow`).
- Names are invented; nothing comes from a real project.
